rules: Place exactly one queen in every row.
Place exactly one queen in every column.
Place exactly one queen in every lettered region.
Two queens must not touch, including diagonally adjacent cells.
Long diagonals are allowed: this is regional Queens, not chess N-Queens.
There is exactly one complete solution. Rows and columns are numbered from 1.
